frontmatter.name: android-apk-reconstruction
frontmatter.description: Reconstruct the externally observable functionality and visual behavior of an authorized reference Android APK in a clean, maintainable native Android project using MVVM, Jetpack Compose, Room, and verified acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Discrepancy Register
nodes.rationale: Documents identified discrepancies between the reference APK and the reconstructed implementation, tracking their resolution status.

nodes.label: Feature Tracker
nodes.rationale: Tracks features identified in the reference APK, classifying evidence and tracking implementation status.

nodes.label: Screen Inventory
nodes.rationale: Maps all screens identified in the reference APK against their reconstructed native Jetpack Compose implementations.

nodes.label: Ralph Progress & Architecture Notes
nodes.rationale: Logs story execution and architectural patterns used during the reconstruction process.
